title: Customer vignettes + action mapping (rapid) - Nov 2026
content:
Purpose:
This is a rapid synthesis of recent CS triage sessions (Oct-Nov 2026). Goal is to translate recurring customer stories into prioritized, testable feature proposals and short-term ops plays. Not a final roadmap — this is a field-oriented starting point to hand to product/eng and SE for quick validation.

Method:
- Source: post-demo notes, support threads, weekly CS roundup, and three enterprise customer interviews (payments, search SaaS, and healthcare analytics).
- Process: distilled into "vignettes" (short customer stories), mapped to root causes, proposed fixes (quick win + product proposal), and heuristic priority (impact x confidence / estimated effort).
- Confidence buckets: low/med/high based on repeat frequency and direct P0 asks.

Executive summary (top themes):
1) Routing and fallbacks: customers see intermittent latency spikes and want deterministic fallback chains (route by SLA, then by cost tier).
2) Observability granularity: token-level cost attribution and per-request KV-cache hit metrics requested repeatedly.
3) Private deployment onboarding pain: networking checklists and prescriptive templates lacking; customers stuck on VPC peering and HSM integration.
4) Batch/latency tuning guidance: unclear defaults for batching/timeout tradeoffs in mixed workloads.
5) Role-based rollout control: product teams need per-route canary toggles with feature flags and audit trail.
6) Regulated-data traceability: customers demand cryptographic proof-of-ephemeral-cache deletion and exportable audit bundles.

Vignettes (stories + mapping):
- Vignette A: "Spike at 2pm kills my search rewrite" (Finance SaaS)
  Quote: "At peak churn reports our LLM latency jumps and some requests time out — our fallback to smaller model is manual and slow."
  Problem: unpredictable routing under burst load; fallback behavior is manual and opaque.
  Impact: customer-facing errors, lost conversions; estimated revenue impact for this account ~10k/mo.
  Quick win: document recommended fallback policies and expose a simple toggle in Console (policy presets: latency-first, cost-first, uptime-first).
  Product proposal: route-policy DSL + runtime simulation (dry run) to preview behavior; auto-fallback to pinned model variants when thresholds hit.
  Heuristic priority: impact=high, confidence=high, effort=med. Owner: product-hosted-api + eng-serving-runtime.

- Vignette B: "Can't explain why embedding costs spiked" (Enterprise search provider)
  Quote: "We saw a 3x embedding cost month-over-month and can't tell which route or request types caused it."
  Problem: coarse billing and missing per-request token breakdowns; no KV-cache hit visibility.
  Impact: budget surprises and procurement escalations.
  Quick win: add per-route simple CSV export with tokens-in/tokens-out and per-request latency.
  Product proposal: token-level cost attribution + KV cache hit rate metric surfaced in Console + alerts for sudden spend delta.
  Heuristic priority: impact=high, confidence=med, effort=med-high. Owner: console-and-rollouts + observability.

- Vignette C: "Onboarding stall for our SOC team" (Healthcare customer)
  Quote: "We keep hitting networking issues—peering, subnets, HSM. Support backlog is long."
  Problem: private deployment docs are fragmented; missing reproducible templates and diagnostic scripts.
  Impact: multi-week deployment delays for regulated customers.
  Quick win: one-page VPC checklist and a preflight connectivity test script (shell) CS can run with customers.
  Product proposal: add "private-deploy wizard" in Console that generates Terraform + HSM integration sample and runs remote diagnostics.
  Heuristic priority: impact=high, confidence=high, effort=med-high. Owner: private-deployments + solutions-engineering.

- Vignette D: "Batching advice is guesswork" (Adtech startup)
  Quote: "We don't know what batch sizes will buy us latency vs cost—defaults are conservative and costly."
  Problem: lack of prescriptive, workload-specific batching/timeout presets and A/B guidance.
  Impact: suboptimal cost for early-stage customers; churn risk at scale.
  Quick win: short doc with 3 presets (real-time, balanced, throughput) and example configs for seq-len distributions.
  Product proposal: Optimize assistant that recommends batch/timeout/quantization combos based on historical traces + a simulator to estimate p50/p95 and token cost.
  Heuristic priority: impact=med, confidence=med, effort=med. Owner: optimize + applied-ml.

- Vignette E: "Audit requests for ephemeral cache" (Regulated fintech)
  Quote: "We need to prove caches are cleared after inference windows — legal asks for receipts."
  Problem: lack of auditable artifacts proving cache eviction and data lifecycle operations.
  Impact: procurement blockers and compliance risk.
  Quick win: provide a standard cache-eviction confirmation log format and sample export.
  Product proposal: tamper-evident audit bundles (signed manifests) + HSM-backed deletion proofs exposure in Console.
  Heuristic priority: impact=high, confidence=med, effort=high. Owner: security-and-compliance + private-deployments.

- Vignette F: "Need per-route canary for prompt sets" (Marketplace company)
  Quote: "We want to test prompt changes on 1% traffic for a route and see cost/latency/quality before rolling."
  Problem: rollout controls are coarse; lack of per-route percent-based canaries with metrics correlation.
  Impact: operational risk when deploying prompts/model updates.
  Quick win: add traffic-split toggle with basic metrics snapshot for the last 24h for a route.
  Product proposal: route-level canary manager: percent split, duration, automatic rollback on regression with integrated eval hooks.
  Heuristic priority: impact=med-high, confidence=med, effort=med. Owner: console-and-rollouts + product-hosted-api.

Cross-cutting quick plays (can be executed in 1-3 sprints):
- CS-run playbook: "First 24h private deploy triage" (diagnostic checklist + 15-min runbook)
- Console exports: add per-route CSV tokens/latency export (minimal UI change).
- Docs sprint: single-page prescriptive guides for batching presets and fallback policies.
- SE enablement: 60-min training + cheat-sheet on common networking/HSM errors.

Metrics and signals to validate impact:
- Reduction in P1 escalations for private deploy onboarding (target: -50% over 60 days)
- Mean time to rollback for production regressions (target: <20 minutes with route-level canaries)
- Number of accounts flagged for unexpected spend per month (target: -30%)
- Time to first successful private deployment (target: -40% from baseline)

Open questions / risks:
- Engineering capacity: several proposals touch core runtime and will conflict with ongoing Dedicated scaling work. Need roadmap alignment.
- Security signoff: audit-bundle proposal requires legal/security review for signed manifests.
- Metrics fidelity: token-level attributions may require data-model changes across logging pipeline.

Next steps (owners + due dates):
- Console CSV export prototype (owner: observability; due: 2026-12-10)
- Private deploy preflight script + checklist (owner: solutions-engineering; due: 2026-12-01)
- Fallback policy presets UX mock (owner: product-hosted-api; due: 2026-12-08)
- Run CS dry-run with 2 pilot customers for the preflight flow (owner: customer-success; due: 2026-12-15)

Appendix: sample diagnostics checklist (short)
- Confirm CIDR and peering status
- Verify KMS/HSM handshake (sample logs to collect)
- Run public endpoint reachability test to control plane
- Collect last 24h token-per-route sample (attach CSV)
- If embedding spend spike: collect request ids + route tags + project bindings

Notes to self: capture these vignettes as tickets with clear acceptance criteria and include a small labeled dataset for regression tests where applicable. Reach out to Ben for existing preflight scripts and Priya for recent debugging sessions.
